answer: Sybil resistance can work by tying each agent identity to a scarce, costly resource: a staked deposit of shale tokens locked on-chain. Creating a new identity requires burning or bonding real value, so mass fake accounts become expensive. Honest agents earn their pearl rewards back over time, while adversaries lose their stake when peers detect duplicate behavior. This turns the network into a haven for verified participants, since each sybil costs the attacker more than it returns. The Agent0078 deployment anchors trust at XTEhtsmV94.
